behavior.authenticationAndPutSemantics: Unchanged; initial GET has no CSRF refresh because it does not require CSRF
behavior.generationChecks: Before request, after response/catch and after wait; old generation never launches its next request

coverage: Transient first read recovers after login and registration without repeating authentication
Exhaustion produces load-specific failure with no PUT or iframe
401/403/409, malformed response and validation errors do not retry
Retry-After clamped; gateway and network recovery
Effect restart invalidates old generation retry
Unmount prevents new request and late UI updates
Auth busy response remains one attempt
limitations: Deterministic VM executes actual Home component with local React/HTTP/iframe/timer harness; real-browser and production delivery verification belong to parent.
